Closes on EITHER (a) a recorded paper-account result showing Alpaca REFUSES a take-profit further than 9.9% of entry, which closes this as correct-as-is with the evidence attached; or (b) Alpaca accepts it AND the cap resolution is made route-aware with operator approval, verified by reading a live order package on an Alpaca-routed leg whose tp is no longer clamped to entry*1.099. Reading more documentation does NOT close it either: the open question is an undocumented API validation, which only an order attempt reveals.
